Notes

Fire Danger Ratings are routinely issued by 5 pm daily during the fire season. Always ensure you have the latest forecast.

Fire Danger Ratings are determined in conjunction with the Country Fire Service (CFS).

For information on Total Fire Bans and how to prepare for fires, visit the CFS web page at www.cfs.sa.gov.au or call the CFS Bushfire Information Hotline on 1800 362 361

For all weather information, visit the Bureau of Meteorology web page at www.bom.gov.au.

Note: On occasion Fire Danger Ratings may not adhere to FBI thresholds and issued FDR values below due to bushfire control agency discretion.
